A_external_frozen_model_evaluation.definition: Run the existing frozen Features 8-15 pipeline (same feature engineering, same preprocessing, same trained weights) on a NEW day's data, with NO retraining, to see how it generalizes.
best_candidates: Friday-02-03-2018 (adds Bot - tests behaviour on an attack type the classifier was never trained to distinguish)
A_external_frozen_model_evaluation.reasoning: Wednesday-28-02-2018 is the most apples-to-apples comparison since it shares the same Benign/Infiltration label set as current training data. Days with entirely different attack types (Bot, DDoS, brute force) will necessarily show the current binary classifier mapping them to Benign or Infiltration in ways that require careful, honest interpretation (the model was never trained to recognize those categories) - useful for documenting generalization LIMITS, not for claiming detection capability on unseen attack types.
